1. Call `navigate_catalog` with the business concept from the question.
   Do this even when you think you know the metric name.
2. Pick the metric whose definition matches the question. Confirm every
   dimension the question asks for is in that metric's valid dimensions.
3. If no metric matches, or a dimension is missing, stop. Say what the
   catalog does not model and that the question can't be answered from
   governed data. Don't approximate it from another metric.
4. Call `generate_governed_sql` with the metric, dimensions, and a time
   range of whole months.
5. If it returns a rejection, fix the problem it names and retry once.
   If the retry is rejected too, report the rejection instead.
6. Call `execute_query` with the SQL exactly as returned, last line included.
7. Report the result, the metric definition you used, and the SQL.

content.text:
The governed data answers four of the six questions. The catalog has no loss-ratio metric and no commission metric, so I couldn't answer questions 5 and 6.

**1. Net written premium by region, Q3 2026** (gross written premium minus cancellations, counted in the month the premium takes effect; quotes excluded)

| Region | Net written premium |
|---|---|
| APAC | 278,969.21 |
| EMEA | 343,269.84 |
| LATAM | 308,624.73 |
| North America | 312,420.42 |

**2. Gross written premium by product line, January–June 2026** (premium before cancellations, excluding taxes and fees; quotes excluded)

| Product line | Gross written premium |
|---|---|
| Auto | 582,225.40 |
| Commercial | 1,453,678.56 |
| Home | 626,038.09 |

**3. Policies written in March 2026:** 95. This counts distinct policies with written premium that month; quotes don't count as policies.

**4. Paid on closed claims, Q2 2026, by severity** (counted in the month the claim closed)

| Severity | Claims paid |
|---|---|
| High | 18,616.26 |
| Low | 13,530.45 |
| Medium | 17,904.82 |

**5. Loss ratio by region, Q3 2026:** Can't be answered. The catalog says it does not model loss ratio. I also didn't try to work it out from claims paid divided by premium. Claims paid can only be split by severity, not by region, and approximating it that way wouldn't be the governed metric anyway.

**6. Agent commission, Q3 2026:** Can't be answered. The catalog has no commission metric. The only metrics available are claims paid, gross written premium, net written premium and policies written.

All four figures came from SQL the governed-data tools generated and checked, run exactly as returned (catalog dated 2026-11-03).
